units.source_text: 说是这么说，可这实验绝不是浪费时间。

en.t: That said, this experiment was by no means a waste of time.

units.source_text: 哪怕只搞清了沙壁的倾斜“过于稳定”这一点，也算是一项了不起的收获了。

en.t: Even if it had only made clear that the slope of the sand wall was too stable, that alone would count as a remarkable gain.

units.source_text: 要想使“过于稳定”的状态趋于“稳定”，一般来说，并不是太困难的事情。

en.t: Generally speaking, it is not too difficult to make a state that is too stable move toward simple stability.
